overview.description: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk is Indonesia's largest state-owned commercial bank with dominant microfinance and sustainable SME lending operations.

news.title: BRI Distributes IDR 764 Trillion in Sustainable Business Activity Loans (KKUB)
news.summary: Bank BRI increased sustainable business credit portfolio to 65.7% of total loan book, complying with OJK POJK 51/2017 and TKBI 2024 green financing guidelines.

news.title: BRI Issues Green Bonds to Finance Micro Renewable Energy & Eco-Agriculture
news.summary: BRI completed stage 3 green bond issuance of IDR 5 trillion to fund solar-powered water irrigation and rural sustainable agriculture.
